name: Thaumaturgy (Mastery of the Mortal Shell) — Intermediate — Seizure

system.description: With a successful Physical Challenge, the thaumaturge causes her target to twist and writhe on the ground in agony. While afflicted, the victim may only bid passive Physical Traits, cannot initiate challenges, and suffers one level of bashing damage per turn. This power lasts one scene and may prove fatal to mortals at the Storyteller's discretion.
